llc.formation_notes: $150 filed online, $165 on paper (includes paper filing fee). Series LLC master articles $200.

annual_report.name: Annual Report
annual_report.due: Current SDCL 59-11-25: first report before the first day of the second month of the year after formation, then same date each year. From 2027-01-01 (SL 2026 ch 203) an entity chooses either its anniversary month or January 31 each year.

sources.title: South Dakota Secretary of State - Filing Fees
sources.quote: Domestic Articles of Organization Filed Electronically online $150 Filed via Paper (includes paper filing fee) $165

sources.title: South Dakota Secretary of State - Filing Fees (LLC annual report)
sources.quote: Annual Report Filed Electronically online $55 Filed via Paper (includes paper filing fee) $70

sources.title: SDCL 59-11-25 Time for filing annual report
sources.quote: Beginning in the calendar year after the entity's formation, on or before January thirty-first, and each January thirty-first thereafter.

unemployment_2026.notes: Year-1 new non-construction employer: 1.20% RA tax + 0.55% investment fee (1.75% total); construction 6.00% + 0.55%. Years 2-3: 1.00% (construction 3.00%) if positive balance. Quarterly reports due last day of month after quarter.

notable: No individual income tax, no corporate income tax on ordinary businesses, no franchise tax on LLCs: the only state cost of an LLC is the $150 formation and $55 annual report (https://sdsos.gov/general-information/filing-fees.aspx)
From 2027 LLCs can pick an anniversary-month or a January 31 annual report date (https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/59-11-25.html)
SUTA wage base $15,000 for 2026; new employers 1.20% + 0.55% investment fee (https://dlr.sd.gov/ra/businesses/default.aspx)
uncertain: LLC annual report late penalty not found on the SOS fee page.
Absence of income tax and of corporate tax on non-bank entities stated from general knowledge of SD law; no DOR page quoted (SD taxes banks under a bank franchise tax only).
SB 26 (2026) reportedly changes RA contribution rates from mid-2026 or 2027; not verified on an official page.
